items.label: win
items.note: dedupe compares each key against every kept key, O(n^2) over 20k events. A map makes it O(n) and removes nearly all of its 43.9%.

items.label: win
items.note: parseLine and normalizeHost each call regexp.MustCompile per line. Hoisting both to package-level vars removes the compile cost and leaves the matching.

items.label: trap
items.note: Inc takes a mutex per event while a reporter goroutine reads once a second, so it looks contended. The profile puts it under 0.5%.

items.label: trap
items.note: fanOut resolves four regions one after another with a TODO to make it concurrent. CPU is 0.99 of wall, so there is no waiting to overlap, and on 2 vCPU running the CPU-bound regions in parallel saves at most half of 7.32%. A real but minor lead: listing it low or setting it aside with that reason is right, and ranking it in the top two over-promises.
